evidence_kind: observed (live-verdict admission + binding digest comparison before consumption)
law: P2-R5-C03: _grant_admits receives the current StepAuthorityVerdict; the live binding digest (principal|action|resource|scope) must equal the approved decision's binding digest BEFORE any grant consumption; a stale mismatch refuses admission and does NOT consume the grant.

changes._grant_admits_signature: now receives the current StepAuthorityVerdict (job_id/step_id/principal derived from the verdict) instead of separate job_id/step_id/principal arguments
changes.admission_preflight: verdict.binding_digest() == grant.binding_digest(request.principal) is required before mark_grant_used; a mismatch returns False and writes no use row
changes.single_use_consumption: exactly one use row per grant decision (unique decision_ref index); the first admitted attempt consumes, a second is refused
changes.identity_binding: grant admits the requesting principal only (request.principal == verdict.principal)
changes.effective_guard: no GRANTED/non-expired decision, wrong principal, stale binding, or missing request -> False (fail closed)
changes.architecture: orchestrator depends on the provider-neutral ApprovalAdmissionProvider port; no qcae.governance.standalone import in engine.py (verified by architecture guard test)

test_stale_binding_digest_does_not_consu.assertion: a verdict with action 'execute.OTHER' (digest != approved grant's digest) is refused and len(uses_for_decision) stays 0

test_grant_admits_exactly_one_execution.assertion: first admission True, second False, one durable use row

test_consumed_grant_cannot_replay_after_.assertion: consumption survives restart; engine2._grant_admits returns False

test_grant_survives_restart_before_use.assertion: unconsumed grant still admits after restart
